reflection.text:
{
  "helped": [
    "inputs/brief.md named the exact create/check commands and the two required requirement rows, so no routing guess was needed.",
    "ai/directives/sdd-v2/module.directive.xml STEP_2_FILL mandated one whole-file Write; that avoided partial skeleton edits.",
    "ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/module-spec-structure.xml and the on-disk skeleton defined section markers and fold points used verbatim.",
    "sdd-new module manifest gave the canonical path and section fill table (call_00_BhifTRjFxhAjw3206XiT2788).",
    "sdd-check --authoring returned actionable diagnostics; its acronym warning drove the only correction (call_00_xgJ0ImChlfE1nrI8MgpX7757)."
  ],
  "friction": [
    "Acronym derivation was missing from authoring inputs: neither brief.md nor the module skeleton stated that requirement/Decision-Log IDs use the filename-derived acronym. I used NORM from SPEC_ID TOKEN-NORMALIZE; sdd-check reported NORM vs NOR. This forced a second whole-file Write (call_00_CKQGeCmSPZE1B3BkKx3j5524). A one-line note in the skeleton or brief naming the derived acronym would have avoided it.",
    "Scope of STEP_5_CLOSE was ambiguous against the benchmark instruction to stop after bounded authoring. module.directive.xml STEP_5_CLOSE requires sdd-log authoring-complete after a clean receipt, which appended NOR-DL-2 to the artifact (call_00_qK48s50X2NpQCaB54lTs3805). The brief did not say whether that receipt was in scope; see uncertainties.",
    "Some discovery Bash calls were avoidable: call_00_2JofdXBP9lDqn66yj7ZL9441 (exit 1, mixed ls/package.json/tsconfig) and broad rg sweeps call_00_IDdh5V6CMnBVuG6igGCT5713, call_00_Pw9Eo8ZB0NC1i7NBOChe5912, call_00_pF0oPI4eUcKFuVDKbGcZ9581. Targeted reads of the named format files would have sufficed. An instruction to read only paths named by the skeleton/brief would test this.",
    "File Structure paths (normalize/normalize.ts, normalize.test.ts) were inferred because the module skeleton's example used ports/adapters and no instruction fixed module-directory-relative vs repo-relative listing. Not flagged by the authoring check; see uncertainties."
  ],
  "uncertainties": [
    "Whether running sdd-log authoring-complete (call_00_qK48s50X2NpQCaB54lTs3805) was expected. It mutates the just-checked artifact by adding NOR-DL-2; the brief asked to stop after bounded authoring. I could not confirm its annotation is ignored by the frozen artifact oracle.",
    "Whether File Structure should list module-relative or repo-relative paths; assumed module-relative.",
    "Whether a Usage Waiver label on the sole public function is optional or required for an external consumer; included it, but it was not independently reviewed.",
    "sdd-check clean output is authoring evidence only; no independent semantic or runtime verification was performed."
  ],
  "nextHypothesis": "If the skeleton or brief stated the filename-derived requirement acronym (NOR) and the exact File Structure path convention before the first Write, the second whole-file Write would be unnecessary; test by adding that line and checking whether one Write plus a clean receipt still yields the same canonical shape."
}
